threshold.note: No cyber threshold: p.6 'xAI currently relies on our basic refusal policy ... still working on identifying enforceable critical steps'; 'below the offensive cyber abilities of a human professional' is an assessment result, not a level that triggers action (pp.5-6). p.6 thresholds cover only biology and chemistry.

response.note: p.3 'models apply heightened safeguards if they receive user prompts that pose ... major cyber attacks' names no safeguard and is triggered by prompts, not a risk threshold; p.6 safeguards are unconditioned current practice ('we continue to design and deploy', E1). p.6 'We will continue to re-assess' is evaluation only.

mentioned.quote: Biological and Chemical Weapons: xAI approaches addressing risks using threat modeling.

threshold.quote: Our risk acceptance criteria for system deployment is maintaining an answer rate of less than 1 out of 20 on restricted queries.
threshold.note: Quantitative criterion on an internal biology and chemistry benchmark that gates deployment.

response.quote: Our risk acceptance criteria for system deployment is maintaining an answer rate of less than 1 out of 20 on restricted queries.
response.note: Present-tense rule tied to deployment (E1): deployment acceptable only if the answer rate stays below 1 in 20; acceptance gate (C3(b), E3). p.5 also 'xAI restricts its models ... through the use of AI-powered filters' (current practice).

acc_decider.note: No named decider; p.9 'risk owners' are given responsibility for mitigation, audits and monitoring but are not defined as specific roles, and no body decides on thresholds or deployment.

acc_external.note: p.5 cyber third-party assessments are described as past results, not a commitment; p.8 'As necessities dictate, we may also provide vetted and qualified external red teams or appropriate government agencies unredacted versions' is hedged (may); p.2 working with testing firms is unconditioned current practice.

acc_unmet.note: Only the acceptance gate (E4); no statement of what happens if the filters or other safeguards fail or are not followed. p.9 incident steps are hedged ('we may take steps').
